contents_body_check.name: contents_body_check
contents_body_check.value:
("contents"."kind" = 'markdown' and "contents"."markdown" is not null and "contents"."object_id" is null)
        or ("contents"."kind" = 'attachment' and "contents"."object_id" is not null and "contents"."markdown" is null)

publications_scope_check.name: publications_scope_check
publications_scope_check.value:
("publications"."scope_kind" = 'note' and "publications"."scope_file_id" is not null and "publications"."scope_path" is null)
        or ("publications"."scope_kind" = 'folder' and "publications"."scope_path" is not null and "publications"."scope_file_id" is null)
